identity.guard_scope: Endpoint audit completed before root was told it could release canonical source holds. Later canonical changes do not retroactively alter the tested checkpoint.

hardware.build: Private development worker: core/local opt0, dependencies opt2, debug0, no incremental; not a packaged release measurement.

runtime_and_native_boundary.reported_and_code_bound_backend: candle-metal-0.11.1; Device::Metal required, no automatic CPU device fallback.
runtime_and_native_boundary.scope: Rust CPU waveform/frontend plus Candle model graph on native AppleMetal via objc2, embedded MSL and Apple framework/driver. Greedy/tokenizer/readbacks remain part of the full API. This is actual native Metal execution evidence, not a pure-Rust/no-FFI claim.
runtime_and_native_boundary.decoder: English [50257,50362], greedy,<=224 new tokens, frozen config suppression plus IDs>=50362; no reference prompt, beam search, sampling, fallback or model-output repair.
runtime_and_native_boundary.timing: Whole Transcriber::transcribe walltime, including CPU frontend, lazy native shader/pipeline work needed by the call, graph, synchronization/readbacks, greedy selection and tokenizer. Model load measured separately; profile wall includes verification/other overhead. No isolated GPU kernel time, cold OS cache or shader-cost attribution.

network_and_lifecycle.same_binary_control: Reachable loopback control succeeded, same-binary sandbox EPERM denial succeeded, then each profile emitted denial before model verification/constructor.
network_and_lifecycle.model_input_policy: Runtime sandbox denies network and writes beneath model/corpus/fixture roots. Compilation used Cargo offline; it is not this runtime-denial proof.
network_and_lifecycle.raw_sequence: Each profile has exactly network_canary/model_verified/decoder_configuration/ready, alternating ordered call_started/call_result pairs, and one complete. Raw events equal execution receipts; every receipt/scored result equals its suite entry.
network_and_lifecycle.window: Separate root release recorded both builds complete and stable app quit before this single invocation. Evaluator did not monitor processes during the actual run; retained release/start/raw-file metadata and fixed source flow are consistent.

dataset.creators: Vassil Panayotov with assistance from Daniel Povey; LibriSpeech paper by Panayotov, Chen, Povey and Khudanpur (2015)

frozen_data_and_scoring.selection: First12 numeric test-clean speakers, first eligible2–30s utterance each; selection frozen before inference. Same12 clips/104.025s/279 strict reference words as CPU baseline.
frozen_data_and_scoring.conversion: Frozen16kHz monoPCM16 WAVs previously matched independent lossless FLAC decoders; actual run hashes match the same buffers and PCM16/32768 f32 little-endian hashes.
frozen_data_and_scoring.synthetic_v2: Original fixed eSpeakNG GPL3-or-later v2 waveform/reference,4.2785s/10 words; no waveform or parameter change.
frozen_data_and_scoring.normalizer: Unicode lowercase; retain alphanumeric or whitespace; split whitespace. All actual references/outputs are ASCII, so Python and Rust character-property tables do not differ for these inputs.
frozen_data_and_scoring.scoring: Independent full-matrix Levenshtein; every distance/token list agrees with the retained weight-free Rust scorer. RTF independently recomputed from API milliseconds and exact sample_count/16000.

thresholds.metric: exact current Rust words and word_errors bodies; no number expansion

frozen_data_and_scoring.quantiles: Sample median; p90/p95 nearest rank ceil(n*p), with no interpolation.

prominent_limits.quality_comparison: All28 Metal raw transcripts are byte-identical to their corresponding retained CPU transcripts; observed improvement is timing for these fixed calls, not accuracy.
prominent_limits.generalization: 12 clean read-English file inputs plus one short synthetic fixture on one M3Max. No live audio/capture route, noisy/overlapping speech, diarization, other language, sustained concurrency, broad quality/reference parity or packaged-app latency result.
